scripts.build: pnpm run cf-typegen && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run cf-typegen && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= opennextjs-cloudflare build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.deploy:upload: pnpm run cf-typegen && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= opennextjs-cloudflare build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= opennextjs-cloudflare upload
scripts.preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build --env development && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env development
scripts.preview:vpc: opennextjs-cloudflare build --env vpc && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env vpc
scripts.check: pnpm run check:static && pnpm run test
scripts.check:generated: pnpm run cf-typegen && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareEnv ./cloudflare-env.d.ts --check
scripts.check:static: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:types && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip
